character: Technical 4.7km circuit used for F1 testing — demands a well-balanced car. Mix of high-speed sweeps and slow technical corners. Tire degradation is a key factor due to high-energy corners.
sources: https://unitedcorsa.com/en-gb/discover/assetto-corsa-competizione/tracks/barcelona (ACC chicane-era layout); https://lemansultimate.com/circuit/circuit-de-barcelona-catalunya/ (distinction from the 14-turn no-chicane layout)

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Brake just before 100m board, 2nd gear, mid-to-late apex. Part of T1-T3 complex
corners.trap: Getting on the kerb too aggressively into the right-left sequence

corners.name: Turn 3
corners.technique: Carry momentum from T1-T2, smooth exit leads to T4
corners.trap: Over-driving T1 entry compromises the entire opening complex

corners.name: Turn 4
corners.technique: Early apex and slowest point, speed reduction early in the corner
corners.trap: Going deep into T4 ruins T5 exit onto the long straight

corners.name: Turn 5
corners.technique: Use a late apex and clean traction to prepare for the following fast left-hand T6
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed into T5 and running wide on exit

corners.name: Turn 7
corners.technique: Brake at entry kerb, 2nd gear. Use camber for grip, smooth through direction change. Early power for T8-T9
corners.trap: Snap oversteer on throttle application at T7 apex

corners.name: Turn 9
corners.technique: Critical corner — exit speed feeds the back straight. Late apex, progressive throttle
corners.trap: Compromising T9 exit by over-driving T7-T8

corners.name: Turn 10
corners.technique: Brake after 100m board, 3rd gear. Turn in under the shadow of the hoarding, miss yellow inside kerbs
corners.trap: Locking up on the downhill approach

corners.name: Turn 12-13
corners.technique: Balance speed through Banc Sabadell T12 and Europcar T13, leaving the car settled for the final chicane
corners.trap: A wide T13 exit compromises the braking line into the chicane

corners.name: Turn 14-15
corners.technique: Keep the car balanced through both direction changes — a clean T15 exit prepares the final right-hand T16
corners.trap: Poor chicane exit means slow final sector and pit straight
